evidence.reference_title: A homozygous SFTPA1 mutation drives necroptosis of type II alveolar epithelial cells in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: ER stress was induced in AEII cells in Sftpa1-KI mice, resulting in activation of the JNK-Ripk3 pathway.

nodes.description: Type II cells in knock-in mice die by RIPK3- and MLKL-dependent necroptosis rather than apoptosis: active caspase-3 was not increased, and deleting Ripk3 or Mlkl protected against fibrosis. Increased phosphorylated MLKL was seen in type II cells of one homozygous patient.

evidence.reference_title: A homozygous SFTPA1 mutation drives necroptosis of type II alveolar epithelial cells in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: The deletion of Ripk3 or Mlkl from Sftpa1-KI mice ameliorated the pulmonary fibrosis, indicating that necroptosis is involved in cell death.

evidence.reference_title: A homozygous SFTPA1 mutation drives necroptosis of type II alveolar epithelial cells in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: To assess whether necroptosis was enhanced in IPF patients with SFTPA1 mutations, we evaluated a patient's expression of phosphorylated MLKL. Although we could assess a lung specimen from only one patient, we detected increased levels of phosphorylated MLKL expression in AEII cells of the IPF patient

nodes.description: Mutant SP-A1 is produced but is not secreted from the cell, and patient alveolar epithelium shows an altered, largely intracellular SP-A staining pattern. The mutant protein can still associate with SP-A2, so wild-type SP-A may also be retained, but a dominant-negative mechanism has not been shown directly.

evidence.snippet: The inhibition of JNK ameliorated pulmonary fibrosis in Sftpa1-KI mice, and overexpression of Ripk3 in Sftpa1-KI mice treated with a JNK inhibitor worsened pulmonary fibrosis.

nodes.description: Transplantation is the treatment for end-stage disease. In a French multicentre series, recipients with an SFTPA1 variant survived better after transplantation than recipients with other surfactant-gene variants. Some SFTPA1 recipients had lung cancer before transplantation, so cancer needs to be looked for.

evidence.reference_title: Outcome of lung transplantation for adults with interstitial lung disease associated with genetic disorders of the surfactant system.
evidence.snippet: In our study, survival of lung transplant recipients with a SFTPA1 mutation was found significantly better compared to patients with other genes involved, whereas the demographics were similar regarding age at diagnosis and ILD histological pattern.

evidence.reference_title: Outcome of lung transplantation for adults with interstitial lung disease associated with genetic disorders of the surfactant system.

evidence.snippet: Two unrelated patients with a SFTPA1 mutation had a personal history of lung cancer before LTx.

nodes.description: Lung adenocarcinoma occurs in carriers and their relatives, sometimes diagnosed together with the fibrosis. Smoking strongly raises the odds, and four of the seven SFTPA1-associated cancers in that cohort came from one family, so the cancer risk of an individual SFTPA1 variant is not known. No frequency is given because the available counts come from referral cohorts.
